questions.question: What does God call Jerusalem in chapter 22?
options: The holy city, set apart for worship
The merchant city, rich with trade
The bloody city, full of idols and injustice
The fallen city, emptied of its people
questions.answer: The bloody city, full of idols and injustice

questions.question: Whom did God seek but not find in Ezekiel 22?
options: A man to stand in the gap before him for the land
A king to lead the whole army out into the battle
A prophet to warn all the people of the judgment
A priest to offer up all of the proper sacrifices
questions.answer: A man to stand in the gap before him for the land

questions.question: Ezekiel 22 says the people had become dross to be melted in the furnace of God's wrath.
I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the _____ before Me.
Her prophets whitewash these deeds with false visions and _____ divinations.
